summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new features in iteration 3: Schedule Board with dropdown remarks and grouped students, Instructors/Students CRUD with new fields, E-Learning page, Recap & OER page, and Flight Notes with rating scale. All backend APIs (14/14 tests passed) and frontend UI components working correctly.

Backend: GET /api/remarks returns 28 remark codes with categories (success, aircraft, weather, instructor, student, notice, support)
Backend: POST /api/schedules with all new fields (instructor_callsign, student_name, exercise, block_off, block_on, remarks, status)
Backend: Auto-duration calculation from block times (e.g., 08:00-09:30 = 90 minutes)
Backend: POST /api/instructors with new fields (cfi_expiry, loa_status, loa_expiry, medical_expiry, email, duty_hours)
Backend: PUT /api/instructors/{id} updates new fields correctly
Backend: POST /api/students with new fields (callsign, license_owned, medical_expiry, email)
Backend: GET /api/students returns students with course info
Backend: GET /api/recap/monthly?month=2026-04 returns monthly statistics
Backend: GET /api/oer/monthly?month=2026-04 returns OER data per aircraft
Backend: POST /api/flight-notes with rating (above_average, average, below_average, unsatisfactory) and stage_type
Backend: All 4 rating options work correctly
Backend: GET /api/ebooks returns list
Backend: GET /api/periods returns 11 periods
Frontend: Sidebar shows E-Learning and Recap & OER links
Frontend: E-Learning page accessible with stage tabs (ALL, PPL, CPL, IR, FIC, ME)
Frontend: E-Learning Upload E-Book button visible for admin
Frontend: Recap & OER page accessible with Rekap Bulanan and OER Pesawat tabs
Frontend: Recap page shows monthly stats (Total Entries, Students Active, Aircraft Used, Instructors Active)
Frontend: OER page shows aircraft OER table with availability, maintenance, optimalization rates
Frontend: Schedule Board cell dialog opens with all fields
Frontend: Schedule Board FI select dropdown works
Frontend: Schedule Board Student select dropdown works (grouped by course)
Frontend: Schedule Board Remarks dropdown shows grouped codes (OK, 1.x Aircraft, 2.x Weather, etc.)
Frontend: Schedule Board Block Off/On inputs with auto-duration display
Frontend: Schedule Board Save/Delete/Cancel buttons work
Frontend: Instructors page shows new columns (CFI Exp, LOA, Medical Exp, Duty Hrs)
Frontend: Instructors form has all new fields (CFI Expiry, Medical Expiry, LOA Status, LOA Expiry, Email, Phone, Duty Hours)
Frontend: Students page shows columns (Nama, Course, License, Medical Exp)
Frontend: Students form has all new fields (Callsign, License Owned, Course, Medical Expiry, Email, Phone)
